description: Create a crowdfunding reward calculator spreadsheet for a Kickstarter campaign. Build a structured spreadsheet with: (1) 5 reward tiers with pricing and costs, (2) Conservative and Optimistic backer count scenarios, (3) Financial calculations showing gross funding, fulfillment costs, and net funding after platform fees, (4) Goal achievement indicators. All calculations must use formulas, not hardcoded values. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
